node.title: Re^2: [RFC] File::Replace
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Do not assume that it will be an atomic operation

Absolutely, which is why I make a point of that both in the root node and the module's [https://metacpan.org/pod/File::Replace#Description|documentation] - the module's job is to do the [doc://rename]. I'll highlight that caveat a little more in the next version.
